title: The azole biocide climbazole induces oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in fish gut.
authors: Lu, Zhi-Jie; Shi, Wen-Jun; Ma, Dong-Dong; Zhang, Jin-Ge; Long, Xiao-Bing; Li, Si-Ying; Gao, Fang-Zhou; Zhang, Qian-Qian; Ying, Guang-Guo
journal: The Science of the total environment
one_liner_zh: 该文研究杀菌剂climbazole对草鱼肠道的氧化应激、炎症和凋亡毒性机制，仅涉及小分子与CYP1A的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Climbazole is an azole biocide that has been widely used in formulations of personal care products. Climbazole can cause developmental toxicity and endocrine disruption as well as gut disturbance in aquatic organisms. However, the mechanisms behind gut toxicity induced by climbazole still remain largely unclear in fish. Here, we evaluate the gut effects by exposing grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) to climbazole at levels ranging from 0.2 to 20 mug/L for 42 days by evaluating gene transcription and expression, biochemical analyses, correlation network analysis, and molecular docking. Results showed that climbazole exposure increased cyp1a mRNA expression and ROS level in the three treatment groups. Climbazole also inhibited Nrf2 and Keap1 transcripts as well as proteins, and suppressed the transcript levels of their subordinate antioxidant molecules (cat, sod, and ho-1), increasing oxidative stress. Additionally, climbazole enhanced NF-kappaB and ikappaBalpha transcripts and proteins, and the transcripts of NF-kappaB downstream pro-inflammatory factors (tnfalpha, and il-1beta/6/8), leading to inflammation. Climbazole increased pro-apoptosis-related genes (fadd, bad1, and caspase3), and decreased anti-apoptosis-associated genes (bcl2, and bcl-xl), suggesting a direct reaction to apoptosis. The molecular docking data showed that climbazole could form stable hydrogen bonds with CYP1A. Mechanistically, our findings suggested that climbazole can induce inflammation and oxidative stress through CYP450s/ROS/Nrf2/NF-kappaB pathways, resulting in cell apoptosis in the gut of grass carp.
abstract_zh: 氯咪巴唑（climbazole）是一种唑类杀菌剂，广泛用于个人护理产品的配方中。氯咪巴唑可对水生生物造成发育毒性、内分泌干扰以及肠道紊乱。然而，在鱼类中，氯咪巴唑诱导肠道毒性的机制仍很大程度上不清楚。本研究通过将草鱼（Ctenopharyngodon idella）暴露于浓度为0.2至20微克/升的氯咪巴唑中42天，并评估基因转录和表达、生化分析、相关性网络分析及分子对接，来评估肠道效应。结果显示，氯咪巴唑暴露在三个处理组中增加了cyp1a mRNA表达和ROS水平。氯咪巴唑还抑制了Nrf2和Keap1的转录及蛋白质，并抑制其下游抗氧化分子（cat、sod和ho-1）的转录水平，从而增加氧化应激。此外，氯咪巴唑增强了NF-kappaB和ikappaBalpha的转录及蛋白质，以及NF-kappaB下游促炎因子（tnfalpha和il-1beta/6/8）的转录，导致炎症。氯咪巴唑增加了促凋亡相关基因（fadd、bad1和caspase3），并减少了抗凋亡相关基因（bcl2和bcl-xl），表明对凋亡有直接反应。分子对接数据显示，氯咪巴唑能与CYP1A形成稳定的氢键。从机制上讲，我们的发现表明，氯咪巴唑可通过CYP450s/ROS/Nrf2/NF-kappaB通路诱导炎症和氧化应激，导致草鱼肠道细胞凋亡。
